ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity (white) pixels to 15% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly high-intensity white field; contiguous low-intensity black border along the entire trailing edge; two distinct, roughly circular black focal spots positioned symmetrically in the mid-upper section of each lobe; irregular low-intensity cluster at the basal center juncture.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 75 degrees; significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations across the trailing edge; multiple sharp peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in depth, isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edge, meeting at the central notch; leading edges exhibit a convex curve tapering towards sharp lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially detected high-contrast dark circular clusters on the lateral mid-lobes; dense, irregular dark pixel clusters with rough texture at both lobe tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruptions near the central lower region; several short diagonal scratches in the lower-left quadrant breaking the pigmentation mapping.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Rough-textured, high-contrast dark protrusions localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; multiple discrete, irregular low-intensity marks across the central fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique symmetrical placement of a single dark circular spot on each lobe.
